purpose: Systematically characterize the already admitted static RossFast D3R production solver against Reference Richards without changing solver semantics, tolerances, architecture or selection policy.

reconciliation.relevant_delta: F-ROSS15 already preregistered and measured a 36-case six-material E0 subset. Current canonical has no RossFast production delta relative to the admitted F-ROSS13 static solver. Later F-ROSS17..F-ROSS22 research/optimization branches are explicitly outside this characterization.

measurement_first_rule: Persist this contract before any new 36-material timing execution or interpretation.

domain.boundary_scope: same fixed-flux E0 family already used by PUB-P2E10/F-ROSS15, restricted to material/forcing combinations admitted by F-ROSS13
domain.case_pairing: Reference and RossFast receive identical initial state, material parameters, forcing, lower boundary, interval and requested outputs.

timing_contract.timed_region: solver solve calls only; case construction, constitutive setup and RossFast table initialization excluded
timing_contract.primary_metric: Fortran CPU_TIME accumulated around selected solve calls
timing_contract.formal_host_boundary: GitHub-hosted timing is screening only; formal production performance claim requires MP-admitted isolated host

reused_evidence.f_ross15: Static RossFast was about 2.91-3.00x Reference CPU on the preregistered six-material 36-case solver-seam subset; shared-host screening only.
reused_evidence.f_ross16: Diagnostic evidence attributes the disadvantage to fixed 24 candidate steps per solve versus 2-12 Reference linear solves, mean 3.89, on the same subset.
reused_evidence.f_ross13: 36-material static production envelope already admitted; do not repeat broad qualification.

next_permitted_action: MEASURE: implement only the locked 216-case static Reference-vs-F-ROSS13 RossFast characterization harness by extending the already qualified F-ROSS15 measurement pattern, then execute the preregistered shared-host screening. Do not optimize or alter solver semantics.
